descriptions.h1b_trim_segment_v2_80217734: Trims a partial external heap segment through its resize callback, rounding to backend quantum and optional heap granularity, preserving minimum24-byte remainder and updating end sentinel on success. For whole-segment release, unlinks before the callback and restores its original list position on failure. External prefixes and byte pointers only; no locally instantiated views or owned initialized data. Captures the segment successor before predecessor search and preserves head versus predecessor lifetimes across the release callback.
